thread:
ana: quick sanity check before we flip canary for mpt-30b-quant — are the AWQ weights in s3 ready and final?
kevin: yes, uploaded this morning. path:```
s3://redwood-models/mpt-30b/awq/2026-03-16/
- awq-4b-v2.tar.gz
- tokenizer.json
- calib/ (1200 prompts, seed=42)
```
devin: note: tokenizer has newline_preserve=false flag in tokenizer.json — that changed tokenization on our long-form evals, small accuracy shift (~0.7%) compared to baseline fp16.
sam: can we quantify that on the holdout? if it's under our threshold i'm fine with canary. i can run a quick eval.
kevin: already ran one: eval set (1k prompts) shows AWQ top1 acc 0.912 vs fp16 0.920 (delta -0.8%). GPTQ run from Feb (s3://redwood-models/mpt-30b/gptq/2026-02-20/) has acc 0.918 (delta -0.2%).
lucas: so AWQ has slightly larger drop vs GPTQ but AWQ is 4x smaller w.r.t memory. tradeoff decision depends on perf/cost curve.
ana: (typo) ana: we need a concrete gating checklist: weights path verified, tokenizer flag decision, calib provenance & sample size, canary rollout plan + abort criteria.
kevin: weights path verified checksum: `sha256:fa3b...` — calib provenance: subset of upstream eval corpus, stratified across domains, 1,200 prompts.
devin: one more head's up: fp8 experimental run showed occasional degradation on >2048 token contexts — example: prompt (truncated) -> model adds unrelated facts after 2600 tokens. not seen in AWQ baseline but seen in fp8 run.
calib-bot: calib report uploaded: /reports/calib-2026-03-16/mpt-30b-awq.json (acc=0.912, ppl=2.31, seed=42).
sam: i'll queue a short GPTQ canary (2h ETA) to compare live traffic. if GPTQ better, we can route canary to it instead or fallback.
lucas: request: add the tokenizer flag change as an explicit toggle in the deploy config so we can A/B enable `newline_preserve=true` if needed.
kevin: good call — will add `tokenizer.newline_preserve` toggle to canary config. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4523 (adds toggle + regen script).
ana: (again) ana: decision: proceed with 1% canary to AWQ with the new tokenizer toggle off by default, monitor accuracy and perplexity. abort if accuracy drops >0.5 absolute or perplexity increases >10%.
infra-bot: started canary job id=cary-2087654321-1 traffic=1% target=awq-4b-v2 region=us-west2
kevin: i'll put a short runbook in the canary doc with metrics hooks (answer-accuracy, token-ppl, latency p99) and a pager in #incidents if thresholds hit.
sam: GPTQ canary queued, will post results here when done.
devin: i'll also add a small prompt set to exercise newline edge cases (100 prompts) and watch for tokenization regressions.
ana: (typo) ana: thanks all — ping me once PR merged and canary is green or if we need to rollback.
kevin: merging PR now, will update when canary flips. :rocket:
sam: noted, monitoring in progress.
calib-bot: alert: canary metrics live: acc=0.911, baseline_acc=0.920, p99 latency=210ms. ongoing.
ana: (typo) ana: keeping an eye — if sam posts GPTQ results we can compare and decide whether to widen or rollback.
kevin: update: PR merged, canary traffic steady. will hold for 2h for stability window.
sam: GPTQ canary finished: acc=0.917, p99=260ms, memory footprint too high for dedicated customers. posted full logs in the PR.
lucas: decision suggestion: accept AWQ for general hosted tier (cost win) but keep GPTQ as an enterprise option for stricter accuracy SLAs.
ana: agree with lucas. I'll write short note to release doc and product for the differentiation. thanks everyone.
